as_of: today (the fixture is shifted so its cycle day 14 is the run day; facts.as_of() unset)
min_n_rule: Any ratio, average or comparison with n < 20 is answered 'Not enough data yet (n = X, need 20)' with the raw counts only.

questions.question: Which ad gave Mark the best leads this cycle?
questions.sql:
select o.ad_id, max(a.ad_name) as ad_name, count(*) filter (where facts.disp_class(o.disposition_code) in ('fit','nofit')) as n,
       round(count(*) filter (where facts.disp_class(o.disposition_code)='fit')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where facts.disp_class(o.disposition_code) in ('fit','nofit')),0),2) as good_fit_rate,
       round(avg(o.quality_score),2) as quality_index
from facts.fact_outcome o join (select distinct ad_id, ad_name from facts.fact_ad_day) a using (ad_id)
where o.broker_id = 'B-MARK' and o.cycle_id = (select cycle_id from facts.fact_cycle where broker_id='B-MARK' and status in ('active','extended') limit 1)
group by o.ad_id order by good_fit_rate desc nulls last, n desc limit 10
questions.n_rule: ratio: every ad needs n >= 20 to be called the winner; below that, list the ads with their counts and say 'not enough data yet'

answer_shape.headline: Name the ad (plain name, not the id) with its good-fit rate and quality score out of 5
answer_shape.comparison: Compare with the all-ads good-fit rate for the same cycle
answer_shape.how_computed: expandable: the SQL plus the metric dictionary definition
answer_shape.caveat: Dispositions arrive after the call, so recent leads are not in yet
answer_shape.next_question: Which angle does that ad belong to, and can we make more of it?

questions.question: What is Mark's show rate this cycle, and is it better or worse than the 14 days before?

union all select 'the 14 days before', count(*), round(count(*) filter (where outcome='attended')::numeric / nullif(count(*),0),3) from o where d <= (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14 and d > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 28

questions.question: Which ad angle has the best qualify rate?
questions.sql:
select a.angle, a.raw as raw_leads, coalesce(q.qualified,0) as qualified, a.raw as n, round(coalesce(q.qualified,0)::numeric / nullif(a.raw,0),3) as qualify_rate
from (select angle, sum(leads_raw) as raw from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14 group by angle) a
left join (select angle, count(*) filter (where qualified and verified_at is not null) as qualified from facts.fact_lead where created_at::date > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14 group by angle) q using (angle)
order by qualify_rate desc nulls last

       round(count(*) filter (where facts.disp_class(disposition_code)='nofit')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where facts.disp_class(disposition_code) in ('fit','nofit')),0),3) as nofit_rate

questions.question: How much did we spend on ads in the last 14 days, and what did a lead cost?
questions.sql:
select (select sum(spend_zar) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) as spend_ex_vat,
       (select sum(leads_raw) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) as raw_leads,
       (select count(*) from facts.fact_lead where qualified and verified_at is not null and created_at::date > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) as qualified_leads,
       round((select sum(spend_zar) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) / nullif((select sum(leads_raw) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14),0),0) as raw_cpl,
       round((select sum(spend_zar) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) / nullif((select count(*) from facts.fact_lead where qualified and verified_at is not null and created_at::date > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14),0),0) as cost_per_qualified,
       (select sum(leads_raw) from facts.fact_ad_day where day > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14) as n
questions.n_rule: mixed: spend is a sum (no n needed); the two cost-per-lead figures need n >= 20 raw leads

answer_shape.headline: Spend in rand, leads, cost of a lead and of a qualified lead against R250 and R400
answer_shape.comparison: Spend excludes 15% VAT; recent leads may not be verified yet

questions.question: What share of qualified leads book a meeting?
questions.sql:
select count(*) filter (where l.qualified and l.verified_at is not null) as n,
       count(*) filter (where l.qualified and l.verified_at is not null and exists (select 1 from facts.fact_booking b where b.lead_key = l.lead_key and b.status <> 'cancelled')) as booked,
       round(count(*) filter (where l.qualified and l.verified_at is not null and exists (select 1 from facts.fact_booking b where b.lead_key = l.lead_key and b.status <> 'cancelled'))::numeric
             / nullif(count(*) filter (where l.qualified and l.verified_at is not null),0),3) as booking_rate
from facts.fact_lead l where l.created_at::date > (select as_of from facts.v_params) - 14
